description: user requested cancel of current operation
cause: User has requested a cancellation of current job.
An invalid username or password was specified.
action: Retry with a valid username and password.

cause: Attempts were repeatedly made to log on with an invalid username or password.
action: Shut down the utility, then restart and retry with a valid username and password.

cause: The operation unexpectedly produced the specified error. Refer to the description of that error for more information.
action: Refer to the description of the reported error for possible actions.

description: unexpected End-Of-File encountered while reading input.
cause: Encountered an End-Of-File while reading the user input.
action: If input to import is being redirected, check the file for errors.

description: failed to allocate memory of size %lu
cause: Unable to allocate the necessary memory.
action: Record the messages that follow and report this to Oracle Customer Support as an Import internal bug.

cause: An attempt was made to free memory that was not allocated.

description: placeholder for Data Pump job error dispatching

action: Specify only one valid mode, then retry.

cause: An invalid combination of parameters was specified.
action: Refer to documentation for the set of valid modes, then retry.

description: table mode imports only allow objects from one schema
cause: Multiple schemas were selected for import.
action: Retry import specifying only one schema.

cause: Fatal internal Data Pump client error.
Could not parse the specified parameter or parameter value.
action: Refer to documentation for valid parameter values.

description: invalid context or job state for parameter, '%s'.
cause: Invalid job state or context for specified parameter.
action: Refer to documentation for correct parameter usage.

cause: Parameter was specified without a value.
action: Refer to documentation for correct parameter usage.

description: Data Pump job is already executing.
cause: Incorrect Data Pump job state for requested operation.
action: Refer to documentation for correct usage.

description: Data Pump client is incompatible with database version %s
cause: The Import utility is at a higher version than the database version and is thereby incompatible.
action: Use the same version of Import utility as the database.

cause: Requested parameter list exceeds 4000 character maximum.
action: Reduce the specified number of parameter values and rerun.

description: Data Pump client is incompatible with Data Pump API.
cause: The Export utility is at a higher version than the Data Pump server and is thereby incompatible.
action: Use the same version of Export utility as the server.

description: unsupported administrative privilege specified in connect string
cause: The connect string specified an administrative privilege that was not supported by the data pump.
action: Specify an administrative privilege that the data pump supports. These are SYSDBA and SYSBACKUP.

description: parameter %s is incompatible with database version %s
cause: An invalid combination of parameters and database was specified.
action: Use parameters that are valid for the database version. Refer to documentation for the set of valid parameters, then retry.

description: unable to establish a session key
cause: The Data Pump command line client and Data Pump server could not negotiate a session key for the encryption password.
An unexpected error occurred during parameter manager initialization.
action: Record the messages that follow and report this to Oracle Customer Support as an Import internal bug.

description: unable to set NLS_NUMERIC_CHARACTERS to required defaults.
cause: Import was unable to set NLS_NUMERIC_CHARACTERS to '.,'
action: Record the accompanying messages and report this as an Import internal error to Oracle Customer Support.

description: incorrect Data Pump client for operation: %s
cause: Import client attempted to attach to export job.
action: Use appropriate client when attaching to an existing job
Refer to documentation for valid client commands.

description: Deprecated Legacy Mode parameter '%s' specified at or on: %s
cause: The Legacy Mode parameter specified has no corresponding Data Pump mapping.
action: Review the location referred to in the error message ( (either 'Command Line', 'Parameter File', or 'Environment Variable') and remove the parameter.
